assets.purpose: Preserve the approved Georgia display and wordmark typography.
requirements: The project specifies Georgia through the operating-system web stack and bundles no font binary. Self-hosting this exact family requires a licensed local font file and documented reuse terms; retain the approved system stack until available.

assets.purpose: Preserve the approved platform system sans body typography.
requirements: The approved body face is a platform-dependent system stack, not one downloadable family. A locally hosted replacement requires an approved specific family, its actual weight files, and a license; retain the verified system stack meanwhile.
